# Version 3.116.0
> **Stable modern platform release** · Released December 2, 2024 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.116.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.116.0)

> **Supersedes [3.0.0](3.0.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.116.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.116.0 stabilizes the modernized 3.0 preview line with .NET 9 and WebAssembly improvements. It rolls up the 3.0 previews, adds WebAssembly SIMD and threading support, expands span APIs, and fixes Blazor and platform rendering issues. Review the API migration notes before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Previously obsolete APIs remain removed** — The stable 3.116.0 release includes the v3 API cleanup from the preview line. Replace obsolete APIs with their documented alternatives and rebuild against the API-diff report. ([#2539](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2539))
- **Platform view APIs use modern targets** — Platform view projects now follow the modern target-framework and package model. Update application project references and platform-specific integrations when moving from v2. ([#2505](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2505), [#2788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2788))

## Engine

- **Skia m116 and refreshed shaping stack** — Stabilizes the Skia m116 renderer and updated HarfBuzz stack introduced during the 3.0 preview cycle. — ❤️ [@Redth](https://github.com/Redth) ([#2829](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2829), [#3026](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3026), [#2624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2624), [#2582](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2582))

## API Surface

- **Span-based geometry and drawing APIs** — Adds span overloads for mapping points and vectors, adding polygons, color filters, rounded rectangles, and pixel access. — ❤️ [@alexandrvslv](https://github.com/alexandrvslv), [@Youssef1313](https://github.com/Youssef1313) ([#3030](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3030), [#2879](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2879), [#2949](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2949), [#2609](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2609))
- **Expanded graphics and animation support** — Adds blender, raw shader, picture-recording, desktop GL, accelerated WinUI, and Skottie animation-builder support. ([#2830](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2830), [#2748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2748), [#2883](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2883), [#2598](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2598), [#2733](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2733), [#2630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2630))

## Bug Fixes

- **Web, Apple, Uno, and MAUI rendering fixes** — Corrects Blazor base-path and .NET 9 behavior, Uno canvas rendering, Metal snapshots, and MAUI view disposal. — ❤️ [@Youssef1313](https://github.com/Youssef1313), [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast) ([#3093](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3093), [#3081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3081), [#3087](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3087), [#2918](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2918), [#2804](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2804), [#2955](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2955))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly SIMD and threading support** — Adds multi-threaded and SIMD WebAssembly builds while aligning SDKs, workloads, and platform targets with current .NET releases. ([#2620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2620), [#2927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2927), [#2971](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2971))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0

Bundles the modernized HarfBuzz binding and shaping stack introduced during the 3.0 preview cycle.
